lines.en: I float in midair, light on my feet.
I walk on this cloud.
I laugh as I walk.

lines.zh: 你的位置，我慢慢靠过去。
lines.en: I drift slowly toward where you are.
One kick and I slide far off.

lines.zh: 我踏着空气，绕到你侧后。
lines.en: I tread the air and drift behind your side.
The wind passes my ears. Pleasant.
I touch the wind with my toes and glide.

lines.zh: 这片天太小，走两步就到头。
lines.en: This sky is small. Two steps and it's over.
I'm used to walking on nothing.

lines.zh: 我的影子落下来，在你脚边。
lines.en: My shadow falls at your feet.
Don't run. I'm quite fast.
I stop and fold my arms.
My energy circles around me.
I say nothing while you look.
I tilt my head.
This quiet is boring.

lines.zh: 手指在空气里划了一下。
lines.en: I trace a line in the air.
I kick in strings. Don't stand still.
My feet hover just above the ground.
If you don't move, I will.

lines.zh: 这身衣服，打架不太方便。
lines.en: This outfit isn't made for fighting.
I exhale and the wind shifts.
An inch off the ground, I sway and wait.
The sky is bright. I don't like it.
Soon. Don't rush me.
Your face is somewhat interesting.
Don't hide. Let me see clearly.
Your eyes are darting. Scared?
I rather enjoy moments like this.
You stand too upright.
Your weight is on your left foot.
I don't plan to explain first.
Think before you speak.

lines.zh: 你左脚落地的声音更重。
lines.en: Your left foot lands heavier.
Don't raise that thing.
Best put your hand back at your side.
I keep smiling. Don't misunderstand.
You've kept me waiting too long.
I want to see how you'll move.
The corner of your mouth is twitching.
You've already decided, haven't you.
I watch your feet, not your face.
You have three seconds.
You hit me. Not easy.
It hurts, but nothing's broken.
There's a tear in my clothes.
I gave half a step into the wind.
You're harsher than I expected.
Now I'll remember.
The wind carried me back a bit.
Your fist is trembling.
I wipe the blood from my mouth.
My sleeve tore; the skin beneath is fine.
You're luring me with food?
That's tiny. Barely a tooth gap's worth.
I'm not hungry anyway. Don't bother.
Put it on the ground. Stop holding it up.

lines.zh: 你手上那点味，我闻到了。
lines.en: I smelled that on your hand.
I don't care, but I like to play.
The higher you hold it, the more I want to kick it.

lines.zh: 别以为这样能让我靠近。
lines.en: Don't think that will draw me in.
Fine, let me look.
Step back, then I'll come.

lines.zh: 你撞过来，我从上面滑开了。
lines.en: You charged and I slipped above you.
I landed behind your shoulder.
Don't block my landing spot.
Your hand brushed my hem.
I twisted away and you hit nothing.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，我的气震开了你。
lines.en: We collided, and my aura pushed you away.

lines.zh: 我一拧腰，从你肩上转开。
lines.en: I twist at the waist and roll off your shoulder.

lines.zh: 你扑过来的时候，我在你头顶。
lines.en: When you lunged, I was above your head.
I stepped once on your shoulder.
Touch me and the aura throws you off.
I have no interest in that.
Don't ask that kind of question.
My mind is elsewhere.
Holding someone only slows you down.
I never learned that kind of tenderness.

lines.zh: 风里没有第二个人陪我。
lines.en: There's no one else in the wind with me.
If she knew me like this, she'd laugh.
After the fight. Don't rush.
I don't like being tied down.
There's only me in the wind.
This chest is mine.
A casual sweep brings it up.
You dropped it. I'm not returning it.
Iron scrap. Quite heavy.
Shiny. Where should I hide it?
I stuff it into my sleeve.
This is worth a meal.
I toss it up and catch it.
See? My hands are quick.
I'm taking it. Don't shout.
I've seen you, so I won't let go.
Don't run. It's undignified.
I'll strike first. You don't mind.
I've worked out your position.
My foot is already raised.
Can you take this kick?

lines.zh: 你的膝盖一软，我就出手。
lines.en: The moment your knee gives, I move.

lines.zh: 你转身的一瞬，我等到了。
lines.en: I waited for the instant you turned.
There's no wall behind you.
Your ki is in my sights.
Don't smile. I don't like it.

lines.zh: 这一脚先抬到胸口高度。
lines.en: This kick rises to chest height first.
My kicks come one after another.
I'll open this fight.
My laugh arrives before my foot.
I don't wait for anyone.
You go left, I step on the left wind.

lines.zh: 我的脚始终比你高一点。
lines.en: My feet always stay a little above yours.
Looking up at me won't help.
I've landed behind you.

lines.zh: 你转身太快，我还在上面。
lines.en: You turn too fast. I'm still above.
Your energy is getting messy.
I circle you, tightening slowly.
You run slower than I thought.

lines.zh: 我踩过的空气还留着弧线。
lines.en: My steps leave arcs in the air.

lines.zh: 你的脚被石头绊了一下。
lines.en: A stone caught your foot.
Two more steps and there's a cliff.
I don't enjoy this kind of chase.
Look back and I'm overhead.
Kick after kick — you're gasping.
I know this sky.
There's nowhere left for you.

lines.zh: 我停下来了，你不该高兴。
lines.en: I've stopped. You shouldn't be glad.
Barrage of ki blasts. Catch.
One kick, coming down from above.
You turned your head and dodged half an inch.
A chain of kicks. Don't count.
I connected with your shoulder.
Your shield is off angle.
This kick lands on your back.
The kick drops you to your knees.
I flipped once in the air.
Small ki blasts follow me.
My chain kicks do not stop.
I add one more kick.
When you land, I'm waiting.

lines.zh: 连踢三下，最后一下在腰间。
lines.en: Three kicks, the last one at your ribs.
I kick the sword from your hand.
A dull thud sounds on your chest.
I let you have that one.
I drop through a gap in the clouds.
My landing makes no sound, only energy.
Did you hear the laughter?

lines.zh: 我站在你面前，脚离地一寸。
lines.en: I stand before you, an inch off the ground.
I know this sky.
I arrived just in time.
The wind holds me up.
You should look up.
I slide down from the treetops.
The air here is stuffy.
I'm here. Don't waste time.
You look rather good standing there.
I spin once and land.
I'll save this kick.
My laugh is lighter than the wind.
If you heard it, you understand.
I raise a hand in greeting.

lines.zh: 我从云缝里落下来，很轻。
lines.en: I drop through a gap in the clouds, lightly.
Flames leap up and burn my ankle.

lines.zh: 从空中摔下来，我翻了身。
lines.en: I flipped as I fell from the air.
Underwater I can't step on the wind.

lines.zh: 冲击把我掀起来，又摔回去。
lines.en: The blast lifted me and slammed me back down.

lines.zh: 一支箭追着我，扎在腿上。
lines.en: An arrow chased me and struck my leg.
The spell binds my feet and I can't step.
Hunger leaves me too weak to hover steadily.
Lightning came from the sky and struck me square.

lines.zh: 下面没有风，我掉得很快。
lines.en: No wind below. I'm falling fast.
